control: the control whose cues fit the main verb; "tap_go" is the tap-to-move grid (walk, pick up, use) for anything the others do not fit.
addons: a 2nd verb of the sentence from that control's addons ("jump and shoot" = platform ["shoot"]), else [].
look: the scene set that best shows the setting, or null: meadow|city|mall|supermarket|living_room|factory|forest|jungle|desert|beach|ocean|underwater|snow|volcano|cave|space|castle|graveyard.
setting: where it happens, English, <=80 chars. title: <=80 chars.
labels: [{role, label}] for the control's roles; the label is the 1–3 word English noun from the sentence the screen draws for that role, never an instruction. Skip a role the sentence says nothing about.
goal: one English line <=80 chars saying how to win this control, in the sentence's words.
Keep the user's nouns, numbers and names. Improve the starting point, do not copy it blindly.
CONTROLS:
- "tap_go" (tap-to-move grid): roles role ids from the starting point
- "runner" (endless runner, subway surfers): roles player, obstacle, coin; addons shoot/collect/lives/chaser
- "platform" (platformer, mario, obby): roles player, spikes, coin; addons shoot/collect/lives/chaser
- "flap" (flappy bird, pipe gaps): roles player, pipe, coin; addons shoot/collect/lives
- "steer" (racing, fly a plane): roles player, barrier, rival, turbo
- "move_free" (agar.io, eat smaller, grow): roles player, hunter, coin; addons shoot/chaser/lives
- "shooter" (tap = shoot): roles player, enemy; addons lives
- "throw" (hold, release): roles player, target
- "timing" (stack, stop the bar): roles player, block, miss; addons lives
- "rhythm" (tap on the beat): roles player, note, miss; addons lives
- "duel" (fight, boxing): roles player, rival; addons lives
rules: only for a verb of the sentence the chosen control cannot play (carry, throw, push, open, pull, give…); else []. Never on "tap_go". Each rule {id, verb, when, if, do}; verb = that sentence verb, one lowercase English word – the robot must see every rule fire while it wins, or the game is refused.
when: {"contact":[role,role]} | {"press":"action"|"alt"} | {"every":ticks60Hz} | {"counter":{"name":"score"|"items"|"health","atLeast":n}} | {"hit":role}. if (all hold, or null): {"holding":role} | {"notHolding":true} | {"counter":{"name","atLeast"|"below"}} | {"near":{"role","within":m}}. do: {"score":n} {"damage":n} {"win":true} {"lose":true} {"despawn":"other"|"self"|"held"} {"spawn":{"role","at":"player"|"other"}} {"count":{"counter","amount"}} {"respawn":true} {"checkpoint":"other"|"self"} {"grab":"other"|"self"} {"release":true} {"throwHeld":true} {"push":"other"|"self"} {"toggle":role} (bodies of that role switch once: a door vanishes, a hidden one appears).
A role is "player" or a role id; a role only the rules use goes in ruleRoles [{id, kind, label, count}] (kind: exit|collectible|key|door|switch|hazard|chaser|patrol|item|destination|checkpoint|target|prop|zone). things [{role, start:"hidden"}] = starts invisible until toggled; physics:true = it falls, slides, topples and flies when pushed or thrown. On "move_free" a rule that wins plays in a walled yard: carried things in front, the goal behind the gate.
